# H5P image-size compatibility

`@lumieducation/h5p-server` 10.0.4 uses image-size v1's synchronous default function with either image bytes or a temporary file path in `H5PEditor.saveContentFile`. The patched image-size 2.0.4 parser retains buffer support but moves file reads to an asynchronous entry point. A plain major-version override breaks the path form.

This private adapter preserves only the synchronous buffer/path API used by H5P, with the same 512 KiB file-header read bound as v1. Parsing is delegated to the actual `image-size@2.0.4` npm package through the clearly named `patched-image-size` alias. It does not copy a parser, pretend to be an upstream release, suppress audit findings or expose additional formats. File descriptors close on success and failure. Unsupported, empty and malformed inputs throw and remain subject to H5P's normal upload-validation handling.

The backend declares the consumed `image-size` name as this local dependency and uses npm's `$image-size` override reference so H5P resolves that same declared package. H5P is the only current consumer of this dependency name. This explicit direct dependency avoids npm's ambiguous relative-file resolution in nested overrides; `npm ls --all` must be valid as well as the audit. The published parser remains separately visible as `patched-image-size`, with its true upstream name/version in the lockfile. Docker copies this directory before `npm ci` so installs from the committed lockfile include the adapter. Regression tests exercise the actual dependency H5P resolves, including buffer/path equivalence, malformed input and bounded/closed file reads.
